items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions Jimmy Lunceford only in the context of a nomination for 'king of swing' by the interviewer. The interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not describe a personal or professional relationship with Lunceford in the provided text.

ctx.x: No, I think Joe played piano. And we did some things around town and somehow I happened to run into Joe Jordan. Don't let me leave out Peek-a-boo Jimmy. Please don't leave him out.
